premise: Parasaurolophus sings good morning to the eggs — a big honk makes them all wobble and Fern shake — so she hums softly instead, Fern sways along, and tap, tap answers from inside: the babies are listening.
inspiration: The cradle-song tradition (singing to the unborn), turned: the babies sing back the only way they can — tap, tap.
lesson: Gentle voices are the easiest to hear.

en-US.title: The Eggs Are Listening
en-US.text: {eggs:enter} {fern:enter} Three eggs sat in their nest, warm and still. {parasaurolophus:enter} Parasaurolophus came to say good morning. {parasaurolophus:go to eggs} {parasaurolophus:face happy} "Hello, little ones!" She took a big breath and, {parasaurolophus:live honk} {sfx:honk} HONK! {eggs:live wobble-all} All three eggs wobbled. {fern:face surprised} {fern:shake} Every one of Fern's fronds shook. {parasaurolophus:face sad} "Oh! Too loud," said Parasaurolophus. "Sorry, sorry." So she tried a softer song, a slow little hum through her long crest. [gently] {parasaurolophus:live sing} Hmm-mm-mm, hmm-mm-mm. {fern:face happy} Fern liked it. {fern:live sway} He swayed along, swish, swish. Then, from inside the front egg, {eggs:live tap} {sfx:tap} tap… tap-tap. {parasaurolophus:face surprised} [whispers] Parasaurolophus stopped. The egg stopped. She hummed again. {eggs:pulse} Tap, tap, tap! [in awe] "They're listening!" {parasaurolophus:face happy} {parasaurolophus:hearts} And every morning after that, Parasaurolophus came to sing, very softly, and every morning, from inside the eggs, little someones tapped along.

es-ES.title: Los huevos escuchan
es-ES.text: {eggs:enter} {fern:enter} Tres huevos descansaban en su nido, calentitos y quietos. {parasaurolophus:enter} Parasaurolophus vino a darles los buenos días. {parasaurolophus:go to eggs} {parasaurolophus:face happy} —¡Hola, pequeñines! Tomó aire y… {parasaurolophus:live honk} {sfx:honk} ¡TUUUUU! {eggs:live wobble-all} Los tres huevos se tambalearon. {fern:face surprised} {fern:shake} A Helecho le temblaron todas las frondas. {parasaurolophus:face sad} —¡Ay! Demasiado fuerte —dijo Parasaurolophus—. Perdón, perdón. Así que probó con una canción más suave, un tarareo lento por su larga cresta. [gently] {parasaurolophus:live sing} Mmm-mm-mm, mmm-mm-mm. {fern:face happy} A Helecho le encantó. {fern:live sway} Se puso a mecerse al compás, fiu, fiu. Y entonces, desde dentro del huevo de delante: {eggs:live tap} {sfx:tap} toc… toc, toc. {parasaurolophus:face surprised} [whispers] Parasaurolophus se calló. El huevo se calló. Volvió a tararear. {eggs:pulse} ¡Toc, toc, toc! [in awe] —¡Nos están escuchando! {parasaurolophus:face happy} {parasaurolophus:hearts} Y desde aquel día, cada mañana, Parasaurolophus venía a cantar, muy bajito, y cada mañana, desde dentro de los huevos, alguien llamaba: toc, toc.

honk.prompt: one big deep friendly honk like a soft low horn, comic, playful

tap.prompt: a tiny beak tapping softly from inside an eggshell, tap, then tap-tap, close, gentle
